description.value: Score on Davie is a long-running sports bar and pub that has operated in Vancouver's West End since 2007, earning multiple 'Best of Vancouver' awards. Known for its Caesar cocktails and a comfort-food menu of wings, burgers, and deep-fried snacks, it draws a lively crowd from the surrounding neighbourhood. The bar has both indoor and outdoor seating and a no-smoking policy.
